title: asperula aristata f. hirta
intro: Asperula aristata f. hirta, commonly known as Wood Sorrel, is a perennial herb belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is known for its edible leaves and flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Wood Sorrel include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in Wood Sorrel include asperuloside, a glycoside with reported cardiovascular and anti-inflammatory effects.
